MSG10.text: Your T-Solve account has been deactivated. Please contact your Admin.

MSG11.text: This email is already used by another account.

MSG12.context: A user account is created successfully

MSG13.context: The Review Queue has no waiting tickets
MSG13.text: No tickets are waiting for review.

MSG15.context: The Project Manager clicks Reject on one or more tickets (a reason is required)
MSG15.text: Reject {count} ticket(s)? Rejected tickets are final: they will not be published and will not return to the review queue. The author will receive the reason by email.

MSG17.text: Changes requested. The author will see your comment in {tracker_name} and receive it by email.

MSG18.context: Hovering over Request changes on a ticket that was not submitted from the Solution Form
MSG18.text: Request changes is only available for tickets submitted from the Solution Form in {tracker_name}.

MSG19.context: The Project Manager clicks Approve with two or more tickets selected

MSG20.context: Approve on a ticket with an empty Solution (the writer closed the Solution Form)
MSG20.text: This ticket has an empty solution and cannot be approved. Request changes or reject it.

MSG21.text: Unpublish this ticket? It will no longer appear in search or in {tracker_name}.

MSG23.text: Re-publish this ticket? It will appear in search and in {tracker_name} again.

MSG25.context: Expired tickets have been sent back to the queue
MSG25.text: {count} ticket(s) sent back to the review queue.

MSG26.context: Feedback has been sent (web app or tracker panel)

MSG27.context: The uploaded file is not a CSV file

MSG28.context: The CSV file is larger than the allowed limit
MSG28.text: File size must not exceed 10 MB.

MSG29.context: The CSV file is missing required columns
MSG29.text: The file is missing required column(s): {column_names}.

MSG30.context: Some rows fail validation in the preview
MSG30.text: {count} row(s) have errors and will not be imported. See the details below.

MSG31.context: The imported Ticket ID already exists
MSG31.text: Ticket ID {ticket_id} already exists. Use a new ID.

MSG33.text: Import failed. No tickets were imported. Please try again.

MSG34.context: The Evidence file type or size is not allowed
MSG34.text: {file_name} cannot be attached. Allowed types: PNG, JPG, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, LOG; maximum size: 10 MB.

MSG35.context: After pulling 100 issues from the ticket tracker, more issues still match the date range
MSG35.text: Showing the first 100 issues. {count} more match this date range; finish this import, then pull again.

MSG36.context: Filling one Solution for several issues when some issues already have a Solution
MSG36.text: Replace the solution of {count} issue(s) that already have one?

MSG37.context: The Project Manager leaves the Import Preview before Finish / Confirm
MSG37.text: Leave this import? Nothing has been imported. Unsaved changes will be lost unless you save a draft.

MSG38.context: On Finish, some issues are skipped because they already have a ticket
MSG38.text: {count} issue(s) were skipped because they already have a ticket: {issue_keys}.

MSG39.context: The import date range is invalid
MSG39.text: Select a valid date range: the start date must not be after the end date, and neither date may be in the future.

MSG40.context: Finish / Confirm when the Project has been removed or the Department has been deleted
MSG40.text: This Project is no longer active. Nothing was imported.

MSG41.context: A Draft is saved successfully (Solution Form, Import Preview, Manual entry)
MSG41.text: Draft saved. Only you can see it.

MSG42.text: Delete this draft? This cannot be undone.

MSG43.context: The Department name already exists (including deleted Departments)
MSG43.text: A Department with this name already exists.

MSG44.context: The review range is not a whole number of 1 or more
MSG44.text: Review range must be a whole number of days, 1 or more.

MSG45.text: Delete {department_name}? Its {count} Project(s) and their tickets will be hidden from everyone and will no longer be reviewed. Nothing is erased; you can restore the Department later.

MSG47.context: The connection test to the ticket tracker project succeeds

MSG48.context: The connection test to the ticket tracker project fails
MSG48.text: Could not connect to {tracker_name}. Check the project and token and try again.

MSG49.context: The ticket tracker project is already linked to a Project

MSG50.context: Pulling issues from the ticket tracker fails

MSG51.context: The Admin clicks Restore on a deleted Department
MSG51.text: Restore {department_name}? Its Projects, members, tickets and Space will be visible again. Each Project must be reconnected by a Project Manager.

MSG53.context: The Project Manager removes a Project
MSG53.text: Remove project {project_key}? The Solution Form and import from {tracker_name} will stop for this Project. Its tickets are kept.

MSG54.context: A Removed Project whose Project Manager has been deactivated
MSG54.text: No Project Manager. Tickets of this Project are not being reviewed.

MSG55.context: The Project Manager removes a member from the Project
MSG55.text: Remove {user_name} from project {project_key}? They will no longer be able to submit or resubmit solutions for this Project.

MSG56.context: The Admin tries to deactivate the last active Admin
MSG56.text: You cannot deactivate the last active Admin.

MSG57.context: The Admin clicks Deactivate on an account that manages no Active Project and no Space
MSG57.text: Deactivate {user_name}? They will be signed out and can no longer use T-Solve on the web or from {tracker_name}. Their tickets and history are kept.

MSG58.context: The Admin deactivates the Project Manager of Active Projects
MSG58.text: {user_name} is the Project Manager of {count} active Project(s). Select a new Project Manager for each Project before deactivating.

MSG59.context: A Project to hand over has no other Active Project Manager in its Department
MSG59.text: No other active Project Manager in {department_name}. Add a Project Manager for this Department first.

MSG60.context: The Admin signs in while the Workspace has no information (Workspace Setup)
MSG60.text: Welcome to T-Solve. Enter your company information to finish setting up the Workspace.

MSG61.context: The ticket tracker site address is not a valid URL
MSG61.text: Please enter a valid site address, e.g. https://company.atlassian.net.

MSG62.context: A user opens the panel without having linked their ticket tracker account
MSG62.text: Sign in to T-Solve to use the T-Solve panel.

MSG64.context: The Project Manager has requested changes
MSG64.text: Changes requested by {manager_name}: "{comment}". Update the solution and resubmit.

MSG65.context: The Solution has been submitted and is waiting for review

MSG66.text: Solution submitted. It is now waiting for review.

MSG67.context: The AI draft cannot be created
MSG67.text: AI draft is unavailable right now. Please write or edit the solution yourself.

MSG68.text: AI rewrite is unavailable right now. Your solution has not been changed.

MSG69.context: T-Solve still cannot be reached after the tracker app retries automatically
MSG69.text: Could not reach T-Solve after several attempts. The issue stays resolved in {tracker_name}, but the solution was not submitted.

MSG70.context: The writer closes the Solution Form (opened after resolving the issue) before clicking Finish
MSG70.text: Close the form? An empty solution will be submitted for review. To keep your work for later, use Save as draft instead.

MSG71.context: The Solution Form is opened after changes have been requested
MSG71.text: Existing evidence cannot be removed. You can add new files.

MSG72.type: Red text below the upload area
MSG72.text: A ticket can have at most 5 Evidence files.

MSG73.context: The sign-in link from the ticket tracker has expired or has already been used
MSG73.text: This sign-in link has expired or has already been used. Go back to {tracker_name} and click Sign in again.

MSG74.context: Waiting for the user to finish signing in in the new tab
MSG74.text: Finish signing in in the new tab. This panel will update when you are done.

MSG75.context: The ticket tracker account has been linked to T-Solve
MSG75.text: Your {tracker_name} account is now linked to T-Solve. You can close this tab and return to {tracker_name}.

MSG76.context: A user who is not a member of any Project in the issue’s Department opens the search box
MSG76.text: Search is not available: you are not a member of any Project in this Department.

MSG77.context: The user has an unsubmitted Solution Form Draft for the issue
MSG77.text: You have an unsubmitted draft for this issue. Continue the draft to submit your solution.

MSG78.context: The Admin removes the Ticket Resolver role from a Project member
MSG78.text: Remove the Ticket Resolver role from {user_name}? They will be removed from {count} Project(s). Their tickets are kept.

MSG79.context: The Admin deactivates a Knowledge Manager or removes their role while they manage Spaces
MSG79.text: {user_name} manages {count} Space(s). Select a new Knowledge Manager for each Space before continuing.

MSG117.context: The Admin assigns a Space that already has a Knowledge Manager

MSG118.context: A Space to hand over has no other active Knowledge Manager
MSG118.text: No other active Knowledge Manager is available. Add a Knowledge Manager first.

MSG80.context: T-Solve posts a suggested solution on a Simple issue (tickets used are not linked)
MSG80.text: T-Solve suggestion: {suggested_solution} Related documents: {wiki_links}. Did this solve your problem? Answer in the T-Solve panel of this issue.

MSG81.context: The reporter opens an issue that received a suggestion
MSG81.text: Did this suggestion solve your problem?

MSG82.text: Great! Your answer has been recorded.

MSG83.text: Thanks. The project team will handle this issue.

MSG84.type: Red text below the upload area
MSG84.context: An uploaded file has the same title as a document in the folder
MSG84.text: A document with this title already exists in this folder.

MSG85.context: The folder name is already used in the parent folder
MSG85.text: A folder with this name already exists here.

MSG86.context: A folder would be deeper than three levels
MSG86.text: Folders can have at most three levels.

MSG87.context: Deleting a folder that is not empty
MSG87.text: This folder contains {folder_count} folder(s) and {document_count} document(s). Move or delete them first.

MSG88.type: Red text below the upload area
MSG88.text: You can upload at most 10 files at a time.

MSG89.type: Red text below the upload area
MSG89.context: A file type or size is not allowed
MSG89.text: {file_name} cannot be uploaded. Allowed types: PDF, DOCX, MD, TXT; maximum size: 10 MB.

MSG90.context: The text of an uploaded file cannot be extracted
MSG90.text: The text of {file_name} cannot be read. Remove it from the upload.

MSG95.context: The Knowledge Manager uploads documents successfully

MSG100.context: The Knowledge Manager deletes a document
MSG100.text: Move {title} to the trash? It will no longer appear in the Wiki or be used by the Knowledge Chatbot.

MSG101.context: A document is moved to the trash

MSG102.context: A document is restored from the trash

MSG103.context: The Knowledge Manager deletes a document permanently
MSG103.text: Delete {title} permanently? This cannot be undone.

MSG106.context: The Knowledge Manager removes a Space access
MSG106.text: Remove the access of {grantee} to {space_name}? They will no longer see the Department documents of this Space.

MSG107.context: The View access of the Space’s own Department is selected
MSG107.text: This access belongs to the Department that owns this Space and cannot be removed.

MSG109.context: No source is found for a question
MSG109.text: I could not find an answer in the knowledge you can access. You can create an issue in {tracker_name} to ask for help.

MSG110.context: A cited Wiki document is no longer available to the user
MSG110.text: This document is no longer available.

MSG111.context: The email belongs to a Deactivated account when adding a user
MSG111.text: This email belongs to a deactivated account. Reactivate it instead of adding a new one.

MSG112.context: The Admin opens their own account
MSG112.text: You cannot deactivate your own account.

MSG113.context: The Admin edits the roles of their own account
MSG113.text: You cannot remove your own Admin role.
